There is important legislation on the table that could change the face of the Republic forever. Valorum wants to discuss it with me before the Senate votes.''"<br />"''And this legislation will affect the Jedi as well?''"<br />"''It will, in ways you cannot even begin to imagine.|[[Valenthyne Farfalla]] and [[Johun Othone]], discussing the proposed governmental reforms|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ruusan Reformations''', also called the '''Ruusan Reformation''', was an event that restructured the entire [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] following the [[New Sith Wars]], taking power away from the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] and reinvesting it in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Reformation==
{{Quote|Do you realize the ramifications of what you are asking, Tarsus? Your proposal calls for the Jedi to renounce their military ranks and completely disband all our military, naval, and starfighter forces. You are asking us to destroy the Army of Light!|Valenthyne Farfalla|<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />}}
[[File:Tarsus_Valorum-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]], the architect of the Ruusan Reformation]]
The reforms were enacted by then-Chancellor [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]]<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" /> and also resulted in the [[Republic Measures & Standards Bureau]] resetting the year zero to the year of the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]],<ref name="HNN 45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_2.html|RM&S; Debates Calendar Reform}}</ref> which would come to be known as [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].<ref name="NEC" />

The Reformations dissolved the [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]], making each system responsible for its own defense; as a result, some of the poorest systems, such as in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], were strained.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> This effectively caused the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi Order]] to undergo a significant adjustment. In symbolic measures, largely to convince the Republic that they would not become a conquering army, the Jedi abandoned their battle armor, renounced all military ranks (such as "[[Jedi Lord]]"), dissolved [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|their commander-in-chief]], disbanded their army, naval and starfighter forces, and placed themselves under the supervision of the Supreme Chancellor and the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]]. 

In order to lessen the chance of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] resurgence, the Order began training children from birth. In addition, the training of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] was centralized on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to remove the danger of unsupervised students delving into forbidden Sith knowledge.

Politically, however, the Reformations did affect representation within the Senate. In an effort to remove corruption and decentralize power away from a few powerful Coreward sectors that held the most representation, Valorum took the then-existing millions of sectors and reorganized them into only 1,024 sectors. Each of the new sectors was granted its own Senator, although a few exemptions were made for politically powerful core worlds to retain their individual representation. Other slots, such as those for species types and cultural entities were also granted.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Reformation Act]] was a critical piece of legislation.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> The [[Armistice Celebrations]] were a holiday that celebrated the anniversary of the Ruusan Reformation.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />

The Reformation put an end to the [[Republic Dark Age]]. It was considered to be the start of the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]]. In some cases, such as [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Declaration of a New Order]] marking the transition of the Old Republic to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Inaugural Edition">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> this event was even marked to be the "official" founding of the Old Republic.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Simultaneously, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane's]] [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] also underwent its own reformation, reorganizing into the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]].<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' established that the Galactic Republic was founded around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]],<ref name="DEsource">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> based on the [[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]] saying that "the Jedi, as is well known, have served as guardians of peace and justice throughout the Galaxy for over 25,000 years"<ref name="DEend">[[Dark Empire endnotes|''Dark Empire'' endnotes]]</ref> and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] line in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']] that the Jedi had been "the guardians of peace and justice in the Old Republic" "for over a thousand generations."<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Furthermore, the Republic appeared in the Legends [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]], which is set in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="GAOTS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref> However, in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] mentioned the Republic had "stood for a thousand years."<ref name="AOTC" /> This at first seemed to conflict with both the [[Star Wars Legends#Official levels of canon|C-canon]] wider history and the [[Star Wars Legends#Official levels of canon|G-canon]] in the films. In [[Star Wars Legends#Official levels of canon|T-canon]], the difference between the Old Republic and the Galactic Republic was addressed in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the TV show ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', making reference to a fallen "Old Republic", in which the Jedi Order was also present, predating the Republic of the Prequel-era.<ref name="The Mandalore Plot">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>

Prior to that, in Legends, the Ruusan Reformation&mdash;in which the Republic is reorganized following the already-established defeat of the Sith a thousand years prior to the films at the Seventh Battle of Ruusan&mdash;<ref name="NEC" />was introduced in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45]]<ref name="HNN 45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|life/13228_2.html|RM&S; Debates Calendar Reform}}</ref> to give an explanation for Palpatine's line, thus bringing all these sources into relative harmony through a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]]. It also explains how, in the context of the Expanded Universe, [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]] could honestly claim, in ''Attack of the Clones'', that there had not been a full-scale war since the formation of the Republic.<ref name="calendar">{{Blog|danwallace|3|Star Wars Calendars}}</ref>

Palpatine's statement that the Republic had "stood for a thousand years" might have been hyperbole - in other words the equivalent of saying the Republic had "stood forever" and was not meant to be taken literally. Given Palpatine's nature as a politician, prone to making grandiose statements and generalizations, gives great weight to this argument. Sio Bibble's remark could also be taken the same way, he may not have considered the earlier wars as "full-scale" or alternatively there could have political revisions to the official Republic history (such as there are in real life) that could have led to majority public opinion that there ''had'' been no earlier wars, when in fact there had been.
